policy: One printed choice, one card; retain all options and the original published tariff. Same marking grid and same topic in all 13 groups.

groups.questionText: Choose one of the roots w, where w ≠ 1. Prove that w² + w³ is real.

selectionChoice.sourceDirective: Choose one of the roots w, where .1 ≠ w
selectionChoice.instruction: Choose any non-unit fifth root from part (i). Show that the imaginary part of w² + w³ is zero.

components.label: Express w² + w³ as a sum of cosines and sines
Show the imaginary part is zero

selectionChoice.instruction: Use two different observations of your choice. Show the substitution for your first observation and your second observation, then solve for A and b.

legacyCards.stem: Atmospheric pressure is measured in kilopascals (kPa) and decreases with altitude.
